# Step - both_v

`both_v` · `bothV` · category: [Walking the graph](../../traversal/step_reference.md#walking-the-graph)

Moves from an edge to both of its endpoint vertices (out vertex first).

## Forms

```text
both_v()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.e("0").both_v().values("name").to_list()   // ["marko", "vadas"]
```
